==Description==
'''D-250''' is the tenth entity and the last entity, where the player will encounter within [[Section D]]. More information about this entity is presented below.

==Mechanic==
'''D-250''' will spawn 3 rooms in front of the currently opened room. The closer the player gets to its location, the more their screen will shake, starting with a gentle movement that is barely noticeable.

When reaching the targeted room, the entity will appear from the ground and generate orbs around it. After a few seconds, these orbs will be flung to random places of the current room, exploding and dealing damage in an area. These orbs damage even while hidden.

When all orbs are thrown, '''D-250''' will slam against the next door, breaking it regardless of type (Depth or Derelict).

== Strategy & Tips ==

* '''D-250'''<nowiki/>'s ambience can be clearly heard when it is about to attack. Keep track of the shake effect, and when the ambience becomes loud enough to hear, quickly run back and stay as far from the next room as possible.
* It is not advised to hide in the most recent room, as '''D-250''' has enough orbs to deal damage that could potentially kill the player.
** This type of situation can occur in later progression.
** Only use the current room as a last resort if you have used at least one [[Items#Healing|Vita-Booster]].

==Trivia==
* '''D-250'''<nowiki/>'s design took about a day to make.
* The particles of it are reused from a scrapped concept by [[User:Collese|Collese]] for the game.
** The particles were meant for [[E-245]], but were used for '''D-250'''.
** The old orb design for '''D-250''' was going to be [[E-245]]'s design but was changed.
* '''D-250''' was revealed in [https://youtu.be/bCtdRPxT01s?si=EyMl0CmJXP6S_sse Update Executive Teaser 5].
